name: limit_delete_base_extrusion
why: IT IS THE DANGEROUS CASE BY NAME: removing the base extrusion makes everything on top of it collapse, and SOLIDWORKS DOES IT WITHOUT ASKING. The holes are its children: deleting it would take them away, and with them the part. It is refused saying WHICH ones are the children, so that whoever reads decides whether to remove them first or whether they had another feature in mind.
_why_a_childs_name_is_searched: and not the word «depend». The first draft of this red looked for «depends», and correcting the sentence to «they depend on it» would have turned the check red on correct code: an assertion on the WORDING breaks every time a comma is fixed. What is needed is that the refusal says the names.

expect.tolerance_why: 400000 minus pi*7^2*20: the calculation has pi inside
